title: Why Safe Water Requires Local Decisions
title_ja: 安全な水に地域の判断が必要な理由

source_links.title: WHO: Small water systems and technology

fact_notes: 背景となる考え方は添付の資料で確認。本文と練習問題は新規制作。例示した人物・学校・活動は架空の説明用設定。

sentences.en: When a new water pump is installed in a village, people may celebrate the arrival of a reliable supply.
sentences.ja: 村に新しい給水ポンプが設置されると、人々は安定した水の供給を喜ぶかもしれません。

sentences.en: A pump can reduce the time families spend carrying water from distant sources, especially during dry seasons.
sentences.ja: ポンプによって、特に乾季に家族が遠くの水源から水を運ぶ時間を減らせます。

sentences.en: However, the presence of a working pump does not automatically mean that the water is safe to drink.
sentences.ja: しかし、動くポンプがあるからといって、水が飲むのに安全だとは限りません。

sentences.en: Water may become contaminated at the source, during transport, or while it is stored in a household.
sentences.ja: 水は水源、運搬中、家庭での貯蔵中に汚染される可能性があります。

sentences.en: This is why water safety is better understood as a continuing process rather than a single construction project.
sentences.ja: このため水の安全は、一度の建設事業ではなく継続的な過程として理解すべきです。

sentences.en: Keeping a supply safe requires local knowledge, clear responsibilities, and money for maintenance over time.
sentences.ja: 安全な水を保つには地域の知識、明確な責任分担、長期的な維持費が必要です。

sentences.en: The World Health Organization recommends managing risks from the water source to the point where people use it.
sentences.ja: 世界保健機関は、水源から人々が使う場所までのリスクを管理することを勧めています。

sentences.en: In practice, this means looking for possible hazards before a serious problem occurs, not just responding afterward.
sentences.ja: 実際には、重大な問題が起こってから対応するだけでなく、事前に危険要因を探すことを意味します。

sentences.en: For example, a community team could check whether heavy rain might wash waste into an unprotected well.
sentences.ja: 例えば地域のチームは、大雨で廃棄物が保護されていない井戸に流れ込む可能性を点検できます。

sentences.en: It might then discuss a protective cover, regular inspections, or a different place to collect water.
sentences.ja: その後、保護用のふた、定期点検、別の採水場所について話し合うかもしれません。

sentences.en: Such decisions depend on the local landscape, available equipment, and the people who will operate it.
sentences.ja: こうした判断は地域の地形、使える設備、それを運用する人々に左右されます。

sentences.en: A solution that works well in one location may be too expensive or difficult to maintain in another.
sentences.ja: ある地域で有効な解決策が、別の地域では高価すぎたり維持が難しかったりする場合があります。

sentences.en: Technical plans are important, yet community participation can determine whether those plans last.
sentences.ja: 技術的な計画は重要ですが、地域の参加が計画の持続を左右することがあります。

sentences.en: If residents do not know whom to contact when equipment breaks, a minor problem may continue for weeks.
sentences.ja: 設備が壊れたときの連絡先を住民が知らなければ、小さな問題が何週間も続く可能性があります。

sentences.en: In addition, a committee that never listens to water users may overlook difficulties faced by older adults or children.
sentences.ja: さらに、水の利用者に耳を傾けない委員会は、高齢者や子どもが直面する困難を見逃しかねません。

sentences.en: A distant collection point may seem reasonable on paper but require a long and unsafe walk in reality.
sentences.ja: 遠い採水場所は図面上では妥当に見えても、実際には長く危険な徒歩移動が必要かもしれません。

sentences.en: Consulting the people who collect water can reveal problems that an engineer might not notice on a short visit.
sentences.ja: 水を運ぶ人に相談すれば、技術者が短い訪問で気づかない問題を明らかにできます。

sentences.en: Community feedback should therefore be treated as evidence for improving a system, not as an obstacle to progress.
sentences.ja: したがって地域の意見は、進歩の障害ではなく制度改善の根拠として扱うべきです。

sentences.en: Imagine that two villages receive identical water filters from the same organization.
sentences.ja: 二つの村が同じ団体から同一の浄水フィルターを受け取ったと想像してください。

sentences.en: In one village, residents receive training and agree on who will replace worn parts.
sentences.ja: 一方の村では住民が研修を受け、摩耗した部品を誰が交換するか合意します。

sentences.en: In the other, nobody is told how the system works or where replacement parts can be purchased.
sentences.ja: もう一方では仕組みや交換部品の購入先について誰も説明を受けません。

sentences.en: Although the equipment is identical, the two communities may experience very different results.
sentences.ja: 設備が同じであっても、二つの地域では結果が大きく異なるかもしれません。

sentences.en: The example does not prove that training solves every problem; money and public oversight still matter.
sentences.ja: この例は研修ですべて解決すると証明するものではなく、資金と公的な監督も重要です。

sentences.en: It does suggest that technology cannot replace the social work of building a dependable service.
sentences.ja: しかし技術が、信頼できるサービスを築く社会的な取り組みの代わりにはならないと示唆します。

sentences.en: For students, water safety offers a useful lesson about development projects more generally.
sentences.ja: 生徒にとって、水の安全は開発事業全般について学ぶよい題材になります。

sentences.en: A successful project should be judged not only by what was built but also by what continues to function.
sentences.ja: 成功した事業は、何が建設されたかだけでなく、何が機能し続けるかでも評価されるべきです。

sentences.en: Measurements of water quality, maintenance records, and user experiences provide different kinds of information.
sentences.ja: 水質測定値、整備記録、利用者の経験は異なる種類の情報を提供します。

sentences.en: Therefore, combining those sources leads to a more complete view than relying on a photograph of new equipment.
sentences.ja: したがって新設備の写真一枚に頼るより、それらの資料を組み合わせた方が全体像がつかめます。

sentences.en: The central question is not simply whether a village has a pump, but whether everyone can rely on safe water.
sentences.ja: 中心となる問いは、村にポンプがあるかだけでなく、皆が安全な水を頼りにできるかどうかです。

questions.prompt: What does the passage mainly argue?
options: Installing equipment is enough to guarantee safe water.
Safe water requires ongoing risk management and local participation.
Water quality depends only on rainfall.
A single filter works in every village.
questions.explanation_ja: 設備導入だけでなく持続的な管理と地域住民の参画が必要という主張です。

options: At the source, during transport, or in storage.
questions.explanation_ja: 水源、運搬中、家庭での保管中という複数の段階が示されています。

options: Risk management from source to consumer.
Waiting until a serious disease outbreak.
questions.explanation_ja: 水源から利用地点までのリスク管理がWHOの推奨として述べられます。

questions.prompt: Why may one successful solution fail elsewhere?
options: Costs and local conditions may differ.
questions.explanation_ja: 地域条件や費用、管理能力などが異なる可能性があるためです。

questions.prompt: Who might a committee overlook without consultation?
options: People who collect water, including older adults and children.
Only the people who designed the filter.
questions.explanation_ja: 高齢者や子どもなど実際の利用者の困難を見逃すと説明します。

questions.prompt: What do the two villages illustrate?
options: Identical technology can produce different results depending on local support.
Training guarantees success in every case.
The first village has a different climate.
questions.explanation_ja: 同一設備でも研修や管理体制で持続性が変わる例です。

questions.prompt: What does 'oversight' most nearly mean in paragraph 4?
questions.explanation_ja: public oversightは公的な監督の意味です。

questions.prompt: Which three kinds of information are suggested for evaluation?
options: Quality measurements, maintenance records, and user experiences.
Rainfall, school marks, and road names.
questions.explanation_ja: 水質、保守、利用者の経験を組み合わせると述べます。

questions.prompt: Why does the writer criticize relying on a photograph?
options: A photograph shows installation but not continued reliability.
A photograph can measure water quality.
questions.explanation_ja: 設置状況と持続的な機能・安全性は別だからです。

questions.prompt: What is emphasized by the final sentence?
options: Counting pumps alone is not an adequate measure of success.
Every village needs exactly one pump.
questions.explanation_ja: 設備の数ではなく、誰もが安全な水を使い続けられることが重要だと締めます。

grammar.focus: does not automatically mean that the water is safe to drink
grammar.explanation_ja: does not mean that〜で『〜という意味にはならない』、that節がmeanの内容です。

grammar.focus: that works well in one location
grammar.explanation_ja: 関係代名詞thatがsolutionを修飾しています。

grammar.focus: but require a long and unsafe walk in reality
grammar.explanation_ja: butで見かけの妥当性と実際の負担を対比しています。
Althoughが譲歩節『設備は同じであっても』を導きます。

grammar.focus: not only by what was built but also by what continues to function
grammar.explanation_ja: not only A but also Bの対比構文で評価基準を二つ並べています。

井戸への流入という具体的な危険を示します。
住民参加の問題に別の論点を加えます。
複数資料を組み合わせるべき結論です。

paraphrases.source: a continuing process rather than a single construction project
paraphrases.rewrite: ongoing management instead of a one-time building effort
paraphrases.explanation_ja: continuing process→ongoing management、rather than→instead ofと言い換えます。

paraphrases.source: may be too expensive or difficult to maintain in another
paraphrases.rewrite: might cost too much or be hard to keep working elsewhere
paraphrases.explanation_ja: too expensive→cost too much、maintain→keep workingと言い換えます。

paraphrases.source: Community feedback should therefore be treated as evidence
paraphrases.rewrite: Residents' responses ought to count as supporting information

paraphrases.source: the two communities may experience very different results
paraphrases.rewrite: the outcomes in the two villages could vary considerably
paraphrases.explanation_ja: may→could、very different→vary considerablyと言い換えます。
